resolutions.role: owner native-resolution workload; borderless keeps the full client visible

notes: Stock-scenario coordinates are landing markers read from each deployed C2 MAP object layer (object id 254), expressed as tile centers. Area 4 is the owner's replacement modded map and uses an analyzed flat, dense-vegetation viewpoint instead; artifact hashes identify the exact data captured. Area baselines use observer mode with no selected huntable dinosaur or weapon, preventing death and close-range creature occlusion while retaining ambient life. Fixed positions and the engine's default heading stabilize terrain composition; ambient actors, animation phase, and wind remain live, so performance conclusions use repeated samples rather than byte-identical images.
